rationale: All five blocking findings of the final round are resolved at HEAD ecdae4508: CR-001 by the owner's recorded decision (known limitation, spec section 7 and the operations guide), CR-002 to CR-005 by the current source. Confidence is medium, not high: CR-003 and CR-004 were verified at every cited site and by the fix-up diff (signature checked; 110 annotated defs against the 107 reported), not by a tree-wide search, and one untyped **filters parameter remains at test_reader.py:524 (list[dict] also remains at test_ingestor.py:479 and test_rollups.py:347) - observations, not findings, since this round adds none. business_review and standards_review are carried forward unchanged by contract, so AC12 and code-quality still read partial from the final round although their findings are resolved; the brief was written to code-review-brief.md.

finding_status.notes: Decision finding. fix_evidence maps this id to outcome 'Option (b): recorded as a known limitation; no code change' with a non-empty rationale (owner's decision of 2026-09-30: the recalculation must not compare client times with the current time, or incremental and full recalculation would disagree by run time). Both mapped artifacts exist and carry the row: spec.md:348 (section 7) and .ai-run/guides/integration/cli-analytics-storage.md:171 (Known limitations).

rollups.py is in changed_files. At HEAD, _SUBAGENT_VALUES duration_ms (rollups.py:1302-1307) is coalesce(<usage event duration>, CASE WHEN tm.ended_at >= tm.started_at THEN <ms between> END): an end before the start gives NULL, which the NULL rule keeps from overwriting a stored value. Pinned by test_a_computed_subagent_duration_is_never_negative (test_rollups.py:988-996). The mapped pytest command records exit_code 0 bound to head ecdae45082e6f3691b6a8bd93483dbd65c1f556d, which equals the current HEAD; it was not re-run here.

All four sites the finding names were read at HEAD: test_otlp.py:108 is test_doubles_render_in_their_shortest_decimal_form; test_otlp.py:529 is test_hook_values_under_typed_keys_are_stored_as_text; cli_analytics_handler.py:62 reads 'the reader may return Decimal, None or int'; vocabulary.py:24 reads 'the hook types and the keys that have a typed column'. Verified at the enumerated sites only: no tree-wide search for other spellings was possible in this run. The AC12 row of business_review is carried forward unchanged by contract.

All twelve modules are in changed_files.
